fields.help_en:
The actual service address of the agent endpoint, which is the HTTPS entry point where the agent runs online. This is a required field with a maximum of 500 characters.
Example: https://my-agent.example.com/mcp

After a caller discovers this agent through DNS, the caller uses this URL to initiate a connection. This is the address where the agent is actually online
fields.help_zh:
该 Agent 端点的实际服务地址，即 Agent 在线运行的 HTTPS 入口。必填字段，最大 500 字符。
例如：https://my-agent.example.com/mcp

作用：调用方通过DNS 发现到这个 Agent 后，拿到这个 URL 就可以直接发起连接。这是 Agent 真正"在线"的地址
fields.name: agent_url

fields.help_en:
An optional URL that points to the metadata description file of the agent (typically in JSON format). This allows other agents or clients to automatically discover the agent capabilities before connecting, including:
Functions supported by the agent
Input/output formats
Version information
Other capability declarations
fields.help_zh:
一个可选的 URL 地址，指向该 Agent 的元数据描述文件（通常是 JSON 格式）。作用：让其他 Agent 或客户端在连接前，可以通过这个 URL 自动发现该 Agent 的能力描述，包括：
Agent 支持哪些功能（functions）
输入/输出格式
版本信息
其他能力声明
fields.name: metadata_url

fields.help_en:
The communication protocol standard that the agent endpoint follows. This determines how callers interact with the agent.

Valid values:
MCP: Model Context Protocol, an agent tool calling protocol developed by Anthropic.
A2A: Agent-to-Agent Protocol, a cross-agent communication protocol developed by Google.
OpenAPI: Standard RESTful API specification (Swagger/OpenAPI).

Other agents or clients use this protocol identity to determine how to invoke the agent. For example, MCP uses the MCP SDK, A2A uses the A2A SDK, and OpenAPI uses standard HTTP requests
fields.help_zh:
声明该 Agent 端点遵循的通信协议标准，决定调用方如何与该 Agent 交互：
协议说明
MCP：Model Context Protocol，Anthropic 推出的 Agent 工具调用协议
A2A：Agent-to-Agent Protocol，Google 推出的跨 Agent 通信协议
OpenAPI：标准 RESTful API 规范（Swagger/OpenAPI）

作用：其他 Agent 或客户端看到这个协议标识后，就知道该用什么方式与它对话。比如 MCP 协议走 MCP SDK，A2A 走 A2A SDK，OpenAPI 走标准 HTTP 请求
fields.name: protocol

AgentRegisterInfoId.description_en: The agent registration ID. This ID is automatically generated by the Alibaba Cloud ATS platform and is globally unique within the platform. During the multi-step registration process through the API, this ID must be carried throughout all steps to associate them with the same agent and complete the full registration workflow
AgentRegisterInfoId.description_zh: AgentRegisterInfoId Agent注册ID。由阿里云 ATS 平台自动生成，在阿里云 ATS 平台具有全局唯一性。在 Agent 注册过程中自动生成，通过API注册的多步流程中，该 ID 必须全程携带，以确保各步骤关联至同一 Agent，完成完整的注册闭环

AtiName.description_en:
The ATI name, which is a globally unique identifier within the ATI trust system.

Example: ati://v1.0.0.www.example.com

ati:// — The protocol prefix that identifies this as a resource in the ATI system.
v1.0.0 — The agent version number.
www.example.com — The domain name (FQDN) bound to the agent
AtiName.description_zh:
ATI名称，在 ATI 信任体系中的全局唯一标识符
示例解析： ati://v1.0.0.www.example.com

ati:// — 协议前缀，标识这是 ATI 体系的资源
v1.0.0 — Agent 版本号
www.example.com — Agent 绑定的域名（FQDN）
